name: Banyuls

limits: For ambré, blanc and rosé wines, Muscat à Petits Grains and Muscat d'Alexandrie together: at most 20%
For traditionnel wine, Grenache: at least 50%

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

blurb.text: A fortified vin doux naturel from terraced slopes of the Catalan Pyrenees in Roussillon, in Languedoc-Roussillon near the Spanish border. Fermentation is stopped by adding alcohol. Its main allowed grapes are Grenache (red, white and gray), Macabeu and Tourbat.
